an5.229:1.1: CCXXIX. Pañc'ime bhikkhave ādīnavā kaṇhasappe. Katame pañca? Asuci, duggandho, sabhīru, sappaṭibhayo, mittadubbhī. Ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā kaṇhasappe.
an5.229:2.1: Evam eva kho bhikkhave pañc'ime ādīnavā mātugāme. Katame pañca? Asuci, duggandho, sabhīru, sappaṭibhayo, mittadubbhī. Ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā mātugāme ti.
